goal: Fail wallet loading with a corruption error instead of triggering a full rescan on startup
Prevent wallets with corrupted transaction records from running in an inconsistent state
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile as no rebase, CI failure, or pending rework blocks review
agreement: General agreement that failing fast is better than triggering endless, unreliable rescans
Unaddressed objection: failing to load locks users out of funds with no recovery option (vicjuma)
Unaddressed objection: error message inverts stored and calculated transaction hashes (jeanpablojp)
Approach approval because rescan cannot repair corrupted records (pablomartin4btc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it stops corrupted wallets from repeatedly rescanning the whole chain on every startup
Prevents running with partially loaded records that bypass spend tracking and conflict caches
